prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body dual-body portrait: left leg at tier L2, right leg at tier L4. ONE woman standing, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, the camera set back so her whole body fits in the frame from the top of her head to her feet, her face still sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Italian woman in 1960s Italian film-star makeup — warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, thick glossy dark-brown hair set in a high backcombed style, a smouldering, confident expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a big silver hoop with a filigree silver drop.

Piercings: On each ear a huge thick rose-gold hoop hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide rose-gold ear cuff, a large rose-gold stud and a small helix ring. All jewelry is real rose gold, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Physique: A towering giantess on an even scale at full head-to-toe height — massive rounded shoulders, huge thick arms, a colossal full chest, a broad heavy torso with a large smooth rounded belly, wide solid hips, her left thigh, down to just above the knee, is part of the vessel above; her entire right leg, foot and glass sandal are part of the vessel above, all the way to the base of each toe.

Material body (underarm line down through the torso and whichever leg sections remain glass): her body below the underarm line — her whole chest, both arms below the shoulder, both hands, belly, hips, and her left thigh, down to just above the knee, is part of the vessel above, and her entire right leg, foot and glass sandal are part of the vessel above, all the way to the base of each toe — is a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass in the exact shape of that part of her body. The vessel is completely filled with perfectly clear, colourless water from the underarm line down through whichever leg parts remain part of the vessel (as described below), with no hollow space and no air gap anywhere inside it (except any tiny real toe-tips noted below). The glass is unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, with bright specular reflections sliding along every curved surface, sharp white highlights and dark refraction edges where the walls are thickest, tiny bubbles trapped in the glass itself. Both arms below the shoulder, both hands, and every finger and knuckle, are the same solid clear glass as the rest of the vessel, with no skin anywhere on them. Small bright fish and slow-drifting water plants in matching tones move freely through the whole filled volume — passing beside and between both hands and every finger, rising through her whole chest, winding around both hips, and drifting through whichever thigh and leg sections remain glass, never crowding, always with open water around each one.

Boundary 1 (skin to material, at underarm height, water reaching the same line): A single straight, horizontal line runs across her body at underarm height, level with both armpits, passing just below her shoulders and across her back. Real skin above this line — her face, neck, both shoulders, and the very tops of both upper arms above this exact height. The glass vessel, already completely full of water right up to this same horizontal line, immediately below it — there is no empty glass anywhere, the water itself reaches exactly up to this line and no higher. Her entire chest, both breasts in full, sit below this line, whole and unbroken, made entirely of the glass vessel and the water inside it — the line passes above her chest, never through it. Shards interlock along this line only.

Left leg transition: On the left leg, a little above the knee, the glass vessel ends in a perfectly flat, deliberately cut cross-section, exactly like a clean slice cut through a cast-glass sculpture — at that flat cut face, the full thickness of the glass wall and the clear water sealed inside it are visible edge-on, the cut always clean, deliberate and precise, never jagged or torn, always the finish of a sculpture. Her real left knee, calf and foot are a separate thing entirely: they simply begin at that same height, flush against the cut face of the glass above them, sharing nothing with it — an ordinary, undisturbed real leg, with real skin, real pores and fine grain, warm in tone, completely opaque, never itself cut, never marked, as if it had always continued naturally from there.

Right leg transition: Her right foot, including its toes, is almost entirely made of the same glass vessel and clear water as the rest of that leg, standing in an extreme platform stiletto sandal carved from that same glass. Only the last few millimetres at the very tip of each toe on the right foot are different — no wider than the toenail itself — where the real toenail and the tiny pad of real flesh just behind it are genuinely real, living flesh. Everything else on that foot — the rest of each toe, the whole foot, and the sandal — is entirely glass. This tiny real tip on each toe is a separate thing entirely from the glass around it, sharing nothing with it — an ordinary, undisturbed real toe-tip, never itself cut, never marked. The glass foot and sandal end cleanly and deliberately right at the base of each of these real toe-tips.

Left leg (real part): her real left knee, calf, ankle and foot, with real skin texture, muscle and soft shadow in every crease. her real left foot stands in a real extreme platform stiletto sandal.

Right leg (real part): only the tiny real toe-tips on her right foot, with real skin texture, muscle and soft shadow in every crease. her right foot stands in a matching glass sandal, carved from the same clear material.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a soft platinum white on one side and a pale silver on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle — glowing evenly, marked with a few thin dark vertical lines spaced evenly across it so the bending of those lines inside her material body is unmistakable, and a glossy dark floor beneath her feet.

Pose: standing tall, body angled 45 degrees, feet planted apart, her left hand (solid glass, every finger and knuckle the same material) resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand (solid glass, every finger and knuckle the same material) relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods her material body from behind, so white light passes through one side and silver light passes through the other, the vertical lines clearly visible bending inside the glass. A soft frontal light falls on her face, ears and any real leg parts. A thin cool rim light traces her whole figure. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
